import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
g=pd.read_csv("guests_churn.csv")
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
best_by_n={}
for n in [50,200,1000]:
    best_by_n[n]=round(max(roc_auc_score(g['churned'].values[:n],np.random.default_rng(s).random(n)) for s in range(40)),3)
shrinks=best_by_n[50]>best_by_n[200]>best_by_n[1000]
print(best_by_n,shrinks)
